==================
On Error Resume Next
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        On Error Resume Next
        DoWork()
    End Sub
End Module

==================
On Error GoTo label
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
        DoWork()
        Return
ErrorHandler:
        Log("error")
    End Sub
End Module

==================
Resume statement
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        On Error GoTo H
        DoWork()
        Return
H:
        Resume
    End Sub
End Module

Resume Next statement

==================
Resume label
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        On Error GoTo H
        DoWork()
        Return
H:
        Resume Cleanup
Cleanup:
        Dispose()
    End Sub
End Module
